第19章 灵桃保卫战三（第1页）
由于新加入的操控阵法的家族修士修为普遍较值守修士高，战斗经验丰富，且是生力军，桃阵的阵法威力大增。
只见，桃阵发出的如雨点般的木箭，向着这两只黑山熊而去。虽然，黑山熊的肉身强大，防御力惊人，但是，在威力大增的箭雨下也是不够看的。
只是一瞬间，这两只黑山熊身上就伤痕累累，血流如注。这两只黑山熊赶紧向远处跑去，再晚些，妖命也就得留在这里了。
见到两只黑山熊的惨样，吓得旁边的妖兽也赶紧跟着退去。再也不敢靠近了。只敢远远用妖术攻击，不过这样对桃阵的威胁也不大了。
见到这种情况，二长老刘秋水让炼气中期的家族修士也去采摘灵桃，由他和六长老刘世盛操控阵法抵挡妖兽的攻击。
由于采摘队伍的扩大，灵桃采摘的很顺利，很快的将这个灵桃园的灵桃采摘完毕！
二长老刘秋水赶紧带领队伍去下一个灵桃园。
出了灵桃园后，发现外面的群妖已经走远了。
在去下一个灵桃园的路上，看到远处的灵桃园仍然进行着人妖大战，各种法术轰击声不绝于耳。
众人赶紧加快了速度，就是路上碰到妖兽也不与纠缠。
由于这个灵桃园距离较远，半个时辰后，众人才赶到。
此时，这个灵桃园的守护灵阵法也已经被攻破了。但是，听到桃园里的战斗声，应该是刚被攻破不久。
二长老刘秋水赶紧带领众人冲进灵桃园。
看到妖兽群正在灵桃园中强夺灵桃，桃园里一片狼藉。
值守的两位家族修士，一人已经倒在血泊中，人已经不行了。另一个家族修士正在艰难的抵抗着，身上也是伤痕累累，看样子也要坚持不了的多长时间了。
这还是绝大部分进来的妖兽忙着吃灵桃，没空搭理他的原因，否则人早死了。
这名家族修士是世字辈的老十四刘世禄，是一名体修，由于是五灵根，修炼到现在只有炼气三层修为。但是由于强大的肉身，不输于炼气中期修士的战斗力，才能一直坚持到现在。

面对这样的情况，二长老刘秋水赶紧带领家族众修士将刘世禄救了下来，在给刘世禄的口中喂了一粒疗伤丹药小还丹后，立即带了家族众修士驱赶妖兽。
为啥是驱赶呢！因为在灵桃园中，要是和妖兽再来一场大战的话，这个灵桃园也就毁了。
好在绝大部分妖兽都吃到了灵桃，像长耳猕猴不紧吃了灵桃，爪子上还拿着灵桃。自然不愿再拼命了。
面对着刘家修士的驱赶，绝大部分妖兽都不情愿的走了，只有个别的妖兽不愿走，被愤怒的刘家修士乱剑砍死。
将群妖赶走后，二长老刘秋水赶紧带人修复损坏的阵法，采摘剩下的灵桃。
看着眼前身死道消的族人和满目疮痍的灵桃园，在场的族人均是满脸悲愤！年老的族人还好，因为这是家族一百多年来不断重复的故事！
几个年轻的族人纷纷悲愤的叫嚣着出去与妖兽群拼命。但是，被二长老刘秋水拦了下来，说道：“你们出去拼命有用吗？你们应该要做的是抓紧修炼，不断强大自己，只有这样才能避免这种事情发生。现在，出去送死吗？”
听到这句话，族人们安静了下来，是啊！还是自己的实力不足啊！否则哪有这样的事啊！
今天的事对刘长旭的触动很大，以前，只是听说这种情况，哪里如亲眼所见印象深刻！刘长旭变强的信念更加强烈！
如他一样深受触动的年轻族人们也纷纷在心中暗暗发誓“要努力变强！”

The latest chapter of The Legend of the Liu Family in Peach Blossom Mountain_Chapter 19 The Battle of Lingtao III Page 1_The Legend of the Liu Family in Peach Blossom Mountain Feiyun Sword Immortal_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 19 Lingtao Defense Battle III (Page 1)
Chapter 19 Lingtao Defense Battle III (Page 1)
Since the newly added family monks who control the formations are generally higher in cultivation than the monks on duty, have rich combat experience, and are fresh troops, the power of the Peach Formation's formations has greatly increased.
I saw the wooden arrows like raindrops sent out by Tao Zhen heading towards the two Montenegro bears. Although the Black Mountain Bear's physical body is powerful and its defense power is amazing, it is not enough to be seen under the powerful rain of arrows.
In just an instant, the two Montenegrin bears were covered in scars and bleeding profusely. The two Montenegrin bears hurriedly ran away. If it were later, the demon would have to stay here.
Seeing the miserable appearance of the two Montenegrin bears, the monsters next to them were so frightened that they quickly retreated. Never dare to come closer again. They only dare to attack with magic from a distance, but this poses no great threat to the Peach Formation.
Seeing this situation, the second elder Liu Qiushui asked the family monks in the middle stage of Qi refining to pick spiritual peaches. He and the sixth elder Liu Shisheng controlled the formation to resist the attacks of the monsters.
Due to the expansion of the picking team, the picking of spiritual peaches went very smoothly, and the spiritual peaches in this spiritual peach orchard were quickly picked!
Second Elder Liu Qiushui quickly led the team to the next Lingtaoyuan.
After leaving Lingtaoyuan, I found that the group of demons outside had gone away.
On the way to the next Lingtaoyuan, I saw that there was still a battle between humans and monsters in the Lingtaoyuan in the distance, and the sound of bombardment by various spells was endless.
Everyone quickly speeded up and did not get entangled with monsters even if they encountered them on the road.
Because this spiritual peach garden is far away, everyone arrived after half an hour.
At this time, the guardian spirit formation of this Lingtaoyuan has also been breached. However, when I heard the sound of fighting in Taoyuan, it must have been captured not long ago.
Second Elder Liu Qiushui quickly led everyone into the Lingtao Garden.
I saw a group of monster beasts snatching spiritual peaches in the peach garden, and the peach garden was in a mess.
One of the two family monks on duty had fallen into a pool of blood and was no longer alive. Another family monk is resisting with difficulty, his body is also scarred, and it seems that he will not be able to hold on for much longer.
This was the reason why most of the monsters who came in were busy eating spiritual peaches and had no time to pay attention to him, otherwise they would have died long ago.
This family monk is the 14th generation Liu Shilu. He is a physical cultivator. Since he has five spiritual roots, he has only cultivated to the third level of Qi refining until now. However, due to his strong physical body, which is not inferior to the combat power of the monks in the middle stage of Qi refining, he has been able to persist until now.
Faced with this situation, the second elder Liu Qiushui quickly led the family monks to rescue Liu Shilu. After feeding Liu Shilu a healing elixir, Xiao Huan Dan, he immediately led the family monks to drive away the monster.
Why is it driven away? Because in the spiritual peach garden, if there is another battle with the monster, the spiritual peach garden will be destroyed.
Fortunately, most of the monsters ate the spiritual peach, such as the long-eared macaque who ate the spiritual peach without hesitation and still held the spiritual peach in his paws. Naturally, I don’t want to fight anymore.
Faced with the drive of the Liu family monks, most of the monster beasts reluctantly left. Only a few monster beasts refused to leave and were hacked to death by the angry Liu family monks.
After driving away the group of monsters, the second elder Liu Qiushui quickly led people to repair the damaged formation and pick the remaining spiritual peaches.
Seeing the dying tribesmen and the devastated Lingtaoyuan in front of them, the faces of the tribesmen present were full of grief and anger! It's okay for the older clan members, because this is a story that has been repeated in the family for more than a hundred years!
Several young tribesmen screamed in grief and anger and went out to fight against the monster beasts. However, the second elder Liu Qiushui stopped him and said: "Is it useful for you to go out and fight hard? What you should do is to practice hard and constantly strengthen yourself. Only in this way can you avoid this kind of thing from happening.. Now, go out and die? "
After hearing these words, the tribesmen became quiet, yes! Or my own strength is not enough! Otherwise, how could such a thing happen?
What happened today greatly touched Liu Changxu. In the past, I had only heard about this situation, but it was not as impressive as seeing it with my own eyes! Liu Changxu's belief in becoming stronger is even stronger!
The young tribesmen who were as deeply touched as him also secretly vowed in their hearts, “We must work hard to become stronger! "
